records.title: Branch Learning in MRI: More Data, More Models, More Training
records.reason: The experiments concern multicontrast cardiac-MRI reconstruction (DualSpaceCMR/VQPrompt/Moero), not language-model inference. The authors report sparse MoE routing slows PyTorch throughput and wall-clock training; the paper does not propose an LLM-serving or inference optimization. The medical reconstruction application is distinct from the linked LLM-expert lineage.

records.title: Shallow Neural Networks Learn Low-Degree Spherical Polynomials with Feature Learning by Learnable Channel Attention
records.reason: Primary arXiv abstract (2512.20562) studies sample complexity and gradient-descent feature learning for shallow two-layer networks on spherical polynomials; it is a learning-theory/training result, not LLM inference.
